hookLine: Can a deodorant ad break the internet? Let's rank the craziest ones.

items.voiceLine: Gillette's 'The Best Men Can Be' ad tackled toxic masculinity head on, and honestly, that's a lot of heavy drama for a shaving cream commercial. Important message, wrong product to sell it with. C-Tier.
But the Old Spice 'I'm on a horse' guy? Fast, absurd, hilarious, and somehow he's already on a boat too. Completely legendary. Absolute S-Tier, without a doubt!

Axe took teenage boys and turned deodorant into a full mythology, waking up buried in supermodels because you sprayed your armpits. Absurd, unforgettable, and every guy born before 2005 can still hum the jingle. A-Tier, pure marketing chaos.

Dove Men Plus Care flipped the script completely, no seduction, no chaos, just real dads being vulnerable about becoming better men. Sincere and well-intentioned, but let's be honest, nobody's replaying it for fun. B-Tier, respectable but forgettable.

outroLine: Old Spice or Gillette? Drop your comment below and subscribe!
